purpose: Teach: 壁画/シビア/カーナビ/ハッピーエンド/ツイ/奏で/豪雨/南国

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 学校の壁画、新しく描かれたよ。
lines.en: The school mural got repainted. It looks really good.
lines.style: Bright opening, lifting up on the revelation. Eager to share something she noticed. Quick pace, genuine enthusiasm — no affectation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。先生の採点、シビアだなあ。
lines.en: Yeah. The teacher who's grading it is being pretty harsh though.
lines.style: Dry, wry half-laugh underneath. Leans back slightly. Not complaining, observing — the cool-distant exterior showing a crack of actual opinion.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 家のカーナビ、最近、調子悪い。
lines.en: My home's GPS has been acting weird lately.
lines.style: Quieter here. Not quite connecting the thread. Thoughtful, searching — like she's thinking out loud without really meaning to.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験、ハッピーエンドで終わる結果に、なりますように。
lines.en: I hope the exam turns out happy in the end.
lines.style: Soft, almost to himself. A small wish cast out into the air. Gentle wistfulness — not self-pity, just honest worry trying to be brave.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスのグループ、ツイ送り合う仲よね。
lines.en: Everyone in our class group is always sending tweets back and forth.
lines.style: Casual, settling back in. Observational tone — she's noticing the social rhythm around her. Light, not detached.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 吹奏楽部、奏でるベートーヴェン、感動した。
lines.en: The band's Beethoven performance really moved me.
lines.style: Bright again, more animated. Genuine appreciation breaking through. Sits forward slightly. Sincere underneath the cool — he actually felt something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 昨日の豪雨で、遠足、延期になった。
lines.en: Yesterday's heavy rain got our excursion postponed.
lines.style: Quieter, more subdued. A small deflation of energy. Accepting but tinged with disappointment — she's reporting the fact, not fighting it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行、南国行きたいって、皆言ってる。
lines.en: Everyone's saying they want to go somewhere tropical for the school trip.
lines.style: Lighter closing. Warm observation, slightly amused at the collective wish-thinking. Pace picks up a little — the conversation finding its natural end on a softer note.
